title: re-sync the pinned `check-half-states.mjs` port to an upstream ref ≥ `a39e385eed` — instruction ④ (decision-box dependency flags) arrives with it; a hand port reds `check:upstream-port-parity` by construction
body:
## What

objectstack's half-state patrol (`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`) gained a report-only inventory section beside its H17 trigger-file index: **Decision-box dependency flags (instruction ④)** — one line per open `needs-user-decision` card that some open card's `Blocked-by:` line names, a `N of M` count pair, a declared NOT-MEASURED number (H4's own count of `pm:blocked` cards with no readable line), and a population-scope line. Landed as objectstack PR #18015 (card objectstack#17968). objectui runs its own copy of the patrol (`.github/workflows/half-state-patrol.yml` + `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`) and its anchor body does not carry the section, so instruction ④'s reading is available on one board and not the other.

## Work item

Port the section to objectui's `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` the way this repo ports patrol rows: `decisionDependentIndex` + `renderDecisionDependents`, wired into both renderers inside the reserved block below H17, the ruling constant verbatim, the self-test battery (two dependents · quiet inbox pair · comment channel with its unread control · NOT-MEASURED equals H4 · cap with overflow). No new request, no second parser: the section is one `Map.get` per decision card over the `Blocked-by:` index the copy already builds for H14. Reference diff: objectstack PR #18015 (`+372 −5`, one file).

## Dedupe keywords

check-half-states · instruction ④ · decision-box dependency flags · Blocked-by reverse index · patrol port

## Source

Filed by the skills execution seat (session `session_01DAcomhvR9kKizeYgg89Vo8`) at objectstack PR #18015's landing, as its ACCEPT (objectstack#17968 comment 5653169259) said it would. Left bare for triage per ruling ③ (grading and routing are triage's; this filer did not pull the board).
